reviews.text: Thank you so much for this excellent rating! Your trust means a lot to us and motivates us to continue providing the best possible care to our patients.
Thank you so much for your trust, Ms. Guevremont! 🐾 …

Brought my elderly cat with multiple conditions for a first appointment. I was very impressed by the clinic. The staff are all very nice, they are efficient and we didn't have to wait in the waiting room at all. The veterinarian, Dr. Bayard, was extremely knowledgeable, took the time to answer my many questions, and was respectful of our opinions and wishes.

Unfortunately had a mixed experience afterwards with the other vet, and especially the vet tech, and the refusal of the clinic to do more blood work/tests when my cat was obviously not well. I wish they would listen to the pet owners more, who know their animal and can tell when they are not well, even if the basic bloodwork looks ok.
Thank you for your review! Our entire team appreciates your trust and is happy to be able to support you and your companion.

I'm perplexed about this place. The veterinarians are empathetic and seem competent, but most of the time, you only see the vet briefly and then deal with the technicians. This is what happened when I had my cat euthanized; I wasn't informed that it would be done by a technician, even though she was kind and I think she did a good job. Afterward, I never heard from them again; they were supposed to send me an ink impression and some resources for coping with grief, which I desperately needed. After a week without any news, I emailed them about it, but I never received a reply. This reinforces my belief that it's better to use independent veterinary clinics.
Thank you for this wonderful review! We're delighted that your experience met your expectations. Your trust means a great deal to our entire team.

Thank you for your positive feedback! ⭐ Our team strives to provide quality care and attentive service with every visit. Knowing that your experience was positive makes us very happy. We look forward to serving you again!
Arrive earlier! At 4:32 PM, the young lady behind the already locked door kindly signaled to me that it was closed :(
Excellent service and advice. I had an emergency and they took care of me immediately the same day. Thank you for everything.

I am extremely disappointed with the service I received at the Animaplus Laurier clinic. I do not recommend it at all.

First of all, one of the receptionists is completely unfamiliar with the veterinary clinic's procedures. I contacted them to have my rabbit (Marcel) neutered as soon as possible. Initially, I was very surprised to learn that it was possible to schedule the operation and the animal's check-up at the same time.
She assured me that this was indeed the case, and since I have a busy schedule, I told her my availability and that I would come the next day to pay and open an account with them to secure my appointment.

The next day, I called back, and the story had changed. The day before, I had asked her three times to confirm that the time slots I had mentioned were correct.

I was told that it was impossible to perform the neutering procedure in a single day.
Anyway, that's not the worst of it. I took the time to inquire and ask questions, particularly about the procedure for this operation; should I feed my rabbit beforehand, should I bring his food, his bedding, etc.?

She told me to keep my rabbit fasted before the operation. For those who don't know, rabbits need to eat constantly and keep their digestive system working. This request poses a major risk to my rabbit's health, especially since it's incorrect. They had to send me an email to correct everything.

It's a serious mistake.

The major problem with this clinic is that if you don't ask questions, no one provides the information. If they do, it's either distorted or incomplete.

I had my rabbit examined to ensure the operation posed no health risks. The veterinarian performed the examination in front of me and confirmed that everything was fine.

However, after the procedure, it appeared that my rabbit had redness inside his ears and that I needed to get this product to remedy the situation.

It's important to know that the vet examined Marcel's ears IN FRONT OF ME and confirmed that there was nothing wrong.

What happened between Saturday and the following Monday with my rabbit's ears, honestly? (Only 48 hours!!!)

And what about the vet's behavior... she was all sweetness and light with my rabbit, but with me? ... She kept interrupting me; I didn't even have time to finish what I was saying before she moved on to someone else. I was talking to her, looking her in the eyes, and she barely reciprocated. She was playing with my rabbit instead of addressing my concerns. When she did answer, it was only partially.

Chloé

I'm not sure that all the tests were necessary even if they don't hurt. I had to leave and a friend had to replace me for the consultation but they mentioned an empty anal gland which was apparently unnecessary. That the cause of the pain was obvious before having it done. Otherwise I was able to consult quickly and professionally. I'm not saying that they tried to add additional costs to me but they didn't avoid them.

Animaplus Laurier has been our vet for the past 7 years for two of our dogs and they are fantastic. The vets take a lot of time to explain options to us and are always open about the costs of treatment options which is often a difficult reality when you have a sick pet. I will never forget how empathetic and helpful Drs Mutch and Kachef were to me when it was time to put my elderly dog to sleep.

The rest of the staff (techs and reception) are equally caring - they all know us and our dogs and make sure the pups feel safe when they’re in the clinic. I have recommended animaplus laurier to many friends and family.

Extremely disappointing customer service.

Unfortunately, I would not recommend this company.

I have rarely encountered such unprofessional and unsatisfactory service. My experience was marked by a blatant lack of professionalism and consideration for the customer.
I was very happy with my first visit, the staff and vet treated me and my cat extremely well and were very kind and helpful.
Absolutely the best team! They treat our babies like family, with so much love and genuine care. Every visit, you can feel that their kindness and dedication truly come from the heart.

Dr. Bayard is simply incredible. He treats animals with the same compassion as all veterinarians should. He always chooses the best option for the animal and never pushes for unnecessary treatments or medications. He works tirelessly and is truly passionate about his work. He has been our vet for about five years, and his diagnoses have always been accurate (bacterial infection, chronic rhinitis, mitral valve degeneration, etc.). He has always provided us with wonderful care. He is a true vet, and many other veterinarians should take a page from his book. We trust him completely to always choose the best for our two little dogs. The rest of the staff is also very pleasant, and we are always well taken care of there. Furthermore, his prices are lower than at other clinics and at the DMV. Thank you to the entire team and to Dr. Bayard!

The reception and care my pet received were truly excellent. All the staff were gentle and attentive to my cat, but unfortunately, I've never felt so insecure as a pet owner. The explanations given by the veterinarian and the technologists were confusing and unclear, especially since I was in shock and very sensitive about my pet's condition. I felt rushed and pressured into choosing expensive treatments throughout my visit and the entire process. Nothing about the options presented to me seemed transparent or honest; they clearly wanted me to spend as much as possible.

Hello Ms. Ruel,
Thank you for taking the time to leave us a positive review. We wish you a pleasant day :)
Helpful and kind. The vet always tries to upsell you on extra services. The prices are high. It's a chain of clinics.
I highly recommend it

This has been the experience that convinced me to come back for regular check ups questions advice etc. They call back to ask you about your pet (love), they consider your relations, they are available when needed. Moutarde does not agree with me, as they insist on weighing him, but for an old rescue with FIV, he is thriving 😻 …

AVOID THIS CLINIC AT ALL COST! My dog suffered a tail injury during a routine anal gland expression at AnimaPlus. Two technicians took him to a back room for the procedure, returning in just minutes. On the walk home, he showed signs of pain and discomfort in his tail, something I'd never witnessed before. At home, he continued to cry and lick his tail. I contacted the clinic right away and returned later that day to see Dr. Bayard. He confirmed my dog was in pain and that his tail was sensitive to the touch. Despite acknowledging the timing of the injury, occurring immediately after the anal gland expression, Dr. Bayard attempted to diagnose unrelated illnesses, disregarding my statement that my dog was perfectly fine before the appointment.

Days later, I received a voicemail from the AnimaPlus director, sounding irritated, requesting to talk to me to know what happened. However, only the technicians know what occurred in the back room. To this day, the clinic has offered no apology or acknowledgment of responsibility. While I'm relieved my dog recovered within a few days, I remain horrified by this experience.

I brought my elderly cat, Lexi, here during an emergency last month. They were able to take her at the last minute and were very kind and supportive. They called to check in on her every day while I was caring for her at home and although she didn’t make it, she really received the best support ❤️‍🩹

They even sent a card for Lexi after her passing. I’m very grateful for the whole team here.

Very caring and lovely people here. We came in for an emergency, and they were very kind, treated our animal friend very well, and provided clear explanations and all the help we could have asked for.
A very attentive veterinarian who proactively follows up with her patients. I highly recommend her!
I am very satisfied with the service from AnimaPlus Laurier! They are professionals with a strong human touch. My Labradoodle, Adèle, adores them!

I'm so grateful to have this vet in the neighbourhood! Dr. Bayard is empathetic and knowledgable, and has been wonderful with my guinea pigs, one of whom has ongoing health issues. The whole team is kind and helpful and I really appreciate that someone always call to follow-up on how your pet is doing. I truly feel like my piggies are in good hands.

Anima Plus Laurier Veterinary Hospital has been the ideal hospital for my birds for twelve years now! Dr. Jean-Marc Bayard is the one who runs it, and what a wonderful veterinarian he is! Very competent, and so kind to all the animals, and …
